sample_unit: All of Us participants (300 cancer, 100 stroke)

links.outcome: Contribution of deterministic safety audit and repair to safety-constraint compliance in ablation
links.effect: Safety audit and repair was the largest contributor to compliance in the cancer cohort; FITTER reached 98.5% compliance versus 75.8-85.8% for comparators.
links.quote: Cancer-cohort ablation identified safety audit and repair as the largest contributor to safety-constraint compliance.

unlisted_practices: Multi-agent LLM architecture integrating wearable and clinical data with condition-specific guideline grounding to generate exercise prescriptions

screen.reason: Evaluates a multi-agent LLM framework (FITTER) for exercise prescription and performs an ablation specifically evaluating the impact of an explicit deterministic safety audit and repair guardrail against safety-constraint compliance, alongside clinician evaluation.
